summary: Make governed artifact identity stable across Git line-ending conversion while binding dirty and untracked files to their actual Git-canonical content.
reason: The execution-gate target-state calculation is a completion control. Raw working-tree byte hashing made the same committed Git content acquire different identities after checkout line-ending conversion. The correction hashes the actual governed file through Git's path-aware clean/EOL filters, preserves deterministic ABSENT state, keeps repository-containment checks, fails closed when Git identity cannot be established, and does not rewrite historical review evidence.
